name: tf-auto-emphasis
title: TF Auto Emphasis
description: Automatic emphasis by term frequency: words repeated in the passage get progressively bolder, so the vocabulary that carries the text rises to the surface — a document outline you can see inside a paragraph.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
